svg.aria-label: Digital signatures and certificates: the sender hashes a message and encrypts the hash with its private key to sign it; anyone verifies with the sender's public key. A certificate is a CA's signature binding a name to a public key, so the receiver can trust that the public key really belongs to the sender.

svg.text: CA signs "this public key belongs to bob.com"
